tool.name: Clank – AI Studio
tool.description: AI studio: chats with projects, folders and repositories, commands with confirmation, image generation, group chat of several assistants.
tool.long_description: Works with the assistants connected in OmniWrench (options > AI assistants) and shares chats and projects with the chat panel. Every project gets its own workspace: local folders, Git repositories and online repositories (GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps – read online or cloned locally). Assistants can list, search and read the workspace, see Git status, log and diffs, propose file changes (shown as a diff) and run commands (shown with an explanation) – both only after confirmation, with an option to remember the answer for the session. What assistants may see is set on the page 'AI access' like for every tool; pseudonymization replaces addresses and names before sending. Files open in a viewer with highlighting and can be attached to the chat. The "Images" tab creates images with the connected image providers (OpenAI, Gemini, xAI, Black Forest Labs, fal.ai, Replicate, Stability AI, Ideogram, Recraft, MiniMax), optionally with reference images; the gallery shows the images of the AI data storage. In the "Group chat" several assistants discuss a topic in turn – with brakes for rounds, contributions, length, time and tokens, pause per round, stop on agreement or repetition, interjections and a summary.

grp.privacy: There are no function calls: the assistants only see the topic, your interjections and the contributions of the others. Pseudonymization follows this tool's "AI access" setting (addresses and names are replaced before sending). Group chats are stored like chats and encrypted if configured.
